description.en: High-utility academic words that often appear in SAT-style passages and Words in Context questions.
description.uz: SAT uslubidagi matnlarda va Words in Context savollarida tez-tez uchraydigan foydali akademik so'zlar.
description.ru: Полезные академические слова, которые часто встречаются в текстах в стиле SAT и в вопросах Words in Context.

back.en: To make something bad less severe or harmful.
back.uz: To make something bad less severe or harmful. Tarjimasi: yumshatmoq, kamaytirmoq.
back.ru: To make something bad less severe or harmful. Перевод: смягчать, ослаблять.

cards.example: Planting grass on the slopes helped mitigate the damage from spring floods.

back.en: To weaken something gradually, often an argument, effort or authority.
back.uz: To weaken something gradually, often an argument, effort or authority. Tarjimasi: zaiflashtirmoq, putur yetkazmoq.
back.ru: To weaken something gradually, often an argument, effort or authority. Перевод: подрывать, ослаблять.

cards.example: A single error in the data could undermine the entire conclusion of the report.

back.en: To confirm a claim by providing additional evidence.
back.uz: To confirm a claim by providing additional evidence. Tarjimasi: (qo'shimcha dalil bilan) tasdiqlamoq.
back.ru: To confirm a claim by providing additional evidence. Перевод: подтверждать (дополнительными данными).

cards.example: Satellite images corroborated the villagers' account of the shrinking glacier.

back.en: Open to more than one interpretation; not clear.
back.uz: Open to more than one interpretation; not clear. Tarjimasi: noaniq, ikki ma'noli.
back.ru: Open to more than one interpretation; not clear. Перевод: двусмысленный, неоднозначный.

cards.example: The ending of the story is ambiguous, so readers still debate whether the hero returned home.

back.en: To support a claim with proof or evidence.
back.uz: To support a claim with proof or evidence. Tarjimasi: asoslamoq, dalillar bilan isbotlamoq.
back.ru: To support a claim with proof or evidence. Перевод: обосновывать, подкреплять доказательствами.

cards.example: The historian could not substantiate the legend because no written records survived.

back.en: Seeming reasonable or likely to be true.
back.uz: Seeming reasonable or likely to be true. Tarjimasi: ishonarli, haqiqatga yaqin.
back.ru: Seeming reasonable or likely to be true. Перевод: правдоподобный, вероятный.

cards.example: A change in water temperature is a plausible reason for the fish leaving the bay.

back.en: New and original, unlike anything before. (Not the noun meaning "a long book.")
back.uz: New and original, unlike anything before. Tarjimasi: yangi, original ("roman" degan ot emas).
back.ru: New and original, unlike anything before. Перевод: новый, оригинальный (не существительное "роман").

cards.example: The students proposed a novel way to collect rainwater using recycled bottles.

back.en: Based on chance or personal choice rather than on a reason or system.
back.uz: Based on chance or personal choice rather than on a reason or system. Tarjimasi: o'zboshimcha, asossiz, tasodifiy.
back.ru: Based on chance or personal choice rather than on a reason or system. Перевод: произвольный, необоснованный.

cards.example: The rule seemed arbitrary until the manager explained the safety risk behind it.

back.en: Focused on practical results rather than on theory or ideals.
back.uz: Focused on practical results rather than on theory or ideals. Tarjimasi: amaliy, pragmatik.
back.ru: Focused on practical results rather than on theory or ideals. Перевод: прагматичный, практичный.

cards.example: Instead of waiting for a perfect plan, the council took a pragmatic first step and repaired the main road.

back.en: To examine something very closely and carefully.
back.uz: To examine something very closely and carefully. Tarjimasi: sinchiklab tekshirmoq.
back.ru: To examine something very closely and carefully. Перевод: тщательно изучать, внимательно проверять.

cards.example: The editor scrutinized every date in the article before it went to print.

back.en: To publicly support or argue for a cause, idea or policy.
back.uz: To publicly support or argue for a cause, idea or policy. Tarjimasi: qo'llab-quvvatlamoq, yoqlab chiqmoq.
back.ru: To publicly support or argue for a cause, idea or policy. Перевод: выступать за, отстаивать.

cards.example: Several doctors advocate later school start times so that teenagers can sleep more.

back.en: To notice or recognize something that is not obvious; to tell things apart.
back.uz: To notice or recognize something that is not obvious; to tell things apart. Tarjimasi: farqlamoq, ilg'ab olmoq.
back.ru: To notice or recognize something that is not obvious; to tell things apart. Перевод: различать, распознавать.

cards.example: In the fog, the sailors could barely discern the outline of the lighthouse.

back.en: To limit or restrict what someone or something can do.
back.uz: To limit or restrict what someone or something can do. Tarjimasi: cheklamoq.
back.ru: To limit or restrict what someone or something can do. Перевод: ограничивать, сдерживать.

cards.example: A small budget constrained the filmmakers, so they shot every scene in one village.

back.en: Based on observation or experiment rather than on theory alone.
back.uz: Based on observation or experiment rather than on theory alone. Tarjimasi: empirik, tajribaga asoslangan.
back.ru: Based on observation or experiment rather than on theory alone. Перевод: эмпирический, основанный на опыте.

cards.example: The team gathered empirical data by measuring soil moisture every morning for a year.

back.en: Existing as a natural, permanent part of something.
back.uz: Existing as a natural, permanent part of something. Tarjimasi: tabiatan xos, ajralmas.
back.ru: Existing as a natural, permanent part of something. Перевод: присущий, неотъемлемый.

cards.example: Some risk is inherent in any journey across the mountains in winter.

back.en: Complete; including all or nearly all parts of something.
back.uz: Complete; including all or nearly all parts of something. Tarjimasi: keng qamrovli, har tomonlama.
back.ru: Complete; including all or nearly all parts of something. Перевод: всесторонний, исчерпывающий.

cards.example: The guidebook offers a comprehensive list of the city's markets, parks and museums.

back.en: To argue or claim that something is true.
back.uz: To argue or claim that something is true. Tarjimasi: da'vo qilmoq, ta'kidlamoq.
back.ru: To argue or claim that something is true. Перевод: утверждать, доказывать.

cards.example: Some researchers contend that the ancient wall was built for trade, not defense.

back.en: To use up a supply so that little or none is left.
back.uz: To use up a supply so that little or none is left. Tarjimasi: tugatmoq, sarflab bitirmoq.
back.ru: To use up a supply so that little or none is left. Перевод: истощать, исчерпывать.

cards.example: Growing the same crop every year can deplete the nutrients in the soil.

back.en: To communicate an idea, feeling or message; to carry from one place to another.
back.uz: To communicate an idea, feeling or message; to carry from one place to another. Tarjimasi: yetkazmoq, ifodalamoq.
back.ru: To communicate an idea, feeling or message; to carry from one place to another. Перевод: передавать, выражать.

cards.example: The poet uses short, sharp lines to convey the speaker's growing anger.

back.en: To become or make smaller, weaker or less important.
back.uz: To become or make smaller, weaker or less important. Tarjimasi: kamaymoq, kamaytirmoq, susaymoq.
back.ru: To become or make smaller, weaker or less important. Перевод: уменьшать(ся), ослабевать.

cards.example: The noise from the highway diminished as we walked deeper into the forest.

back.en: To encourage the growth or development of something.
back.uz: To encourage the growth or development of something. Tarjimasi: rivojlantirmoq, rag'batlantirmoq.
back.ru: To encourage the growth or development of something. Перевод: развивать, способствовать, поощрять.

cards.example: The school garden fosters teamwork among students from different grades.

back.en: To make something slower or more difficult; to get in the way.
back.uz: To make something slower or more difficult; to get in the way. Tarjimasi: to'sqinlik qilmoq, xalal bermoq.
back.ru: To make something slower or more difficult; to get in the way. Перевод: мешать, препятствовать.

cards.example: Heavy snow hindered the rescue team's progress up the valley.

back.en: To suggest something without saying it directly. (The speaker implies; the listener infers.)
back.uz: To suggest something without saying it directly. Tarjimasi: nazarda tutmoq, ishora qilmoq. (Gapiruvchi imply qiladi, tinglovchi infer qiladi.)
back.ru: To suggest something without saying it directly. Перевод: подразумевать, намекать. (Говорящий implies, слушающий infers.)

cards.example: By checking her watch twice, the guide implied that the tour was running late.

back.en: To reach a conclusion from evidence or clues rather than from direct statements.
back.uz: To reach a conclusion from evidence or clues rather than from direct statements. Tarjimasi: xulosa chiqarmoq.
back.ru: To reach a conclusion from evidence or clues rather than from direct statements. Перевод: делать вывод, заключать.

cards.example: From the muddy boots by the door, we inferred that someone had just come in from the field.

back.en: Widespread; common in a particular place or time.
back.uz: Widespread; common in a particular place or time. Tarjimasi: keng tarqalgan.
back.ru: Widespread; common in a particular place or time. Перевод: распространённый, преобладающий.

cards.example: Hand-painted tiles were prevalent in the region's buildings during the fifteenth century.

back.en: To prove that a statement or argument is wrong.
back.uz: To prove that a statement or argument is wrong. Tarjimasi: rad etmoq, (dalil bilan) inkor qilmoq.
back.ru: To prove that a statement or argument is wrong. Перевод: опровергать.

cards.example: New measurements refuted the old belief that the lake had no underground source.

back.en: To make two different ideas or facts fit together; to restore friendly relations.
back.uz: To make two different ideas or facts fit together; to restore friendly relations. Tarjimasi: muvofiqlashtirmoq, yarashtirmoq.
back.ru: To make two different ideas or facts fit together; to restore friendly relations. Перевод: согласовывать, примирять.

cards.example: The scientist tried to reconcile the lab results with what she had observed in the wild.

back.en: Strong and reliable; able to hold up under pressure or testing.
back.uz: Strong and reliable; able to hold up under pressure or testing. Tarjimasi: mustahkam, ishonchli.
back.ru: Strong and reliable; able to hold up under pressure or testing. Перевод: надёжный, устойчивый, крепкий.

cards.example: The finding proved robust: it appeared again in three separate studies.

back.en: Doubtful; not easily convinced that something is true.
back.uz: Doubtful; not easily convinced that something is true. Tarjimasi: shubha bilan qaraydigan, skeptik.
back.ru: Doubtful; not easily convinced that something is true. Перевод: скептический, сомневающийся.

cards.example: Many readers were skeptical of the diary until experts confirmed its age.

back.en: To form ideas or guesses without firm evidence.
back.uz: To form ideas or guesses without firm evidence. Tarjimasi: taxmin qilmoq, faraz qilmoq.
back.ru: To form ideas or guesses without firm evidence. Перевод: строить догадки, предполагать.

cards.example: Without more fossils, scientists can only speculate about the animal's diet.

back.en: Not obvious; small or delicate and therefore hard to notice.
back.uz: Not obvious; small or delicate and therefore hard to notice. Tarjimasi: nozik, deyarli sezilmaydigan.
back.ru: Not obvious; small or delicate and therefore hard to notice. Перевод: тонкий, едва заметный.

cards.example: The painter used subtle changes in color to show the passing of the afternoon.

back.en: Not certain or final; done with hesitation.
back.uz: Not certain or final; done with hesitation. Tarjimasi: taxminiy, dastlabki, ikkilanib qilingan.
back.ru: Not certain or final; done with hesitation. Перевод: предварительный, неуверенный.

cards.example: The committee reached a tentative agreement but planned to vote again next month.

back.en: Capable of working successfully; practical and realistic.
back.uz: Capable of working successfully; practical and realistic. Tarjimasi: amalga oshirsa bo'ladigan, hayotiy.
back.ru: Capable of working successfully; practical and realistic. Перевод: жизнеспособный, осуществимый.

cards.example: Wind power became a viable option for the island once cheaper turbines were available.

back.en: To produce or provide a result; also, to give way to pressure or to others.
back.uz: To produce or provide a result; also, to give way to pressure or to others. Tarjimasi: natija bermoq, hosil bermoq; yon bermoq.
back.ru: To produce or provide a result; also, to give way to pressure or to others. Перевод: давать (результат, урожай); уступать.

cards.example: The second round of interviews yielded far more useful information than the first.

back.en: Something that differs from what is normal or expected.
back.uz: Something that differs from what is normal or expected. Tarjimasi: anomaliya, odatdagidan chetga chiqish.
back.ru: Something that differs from what is normal or expected. Перевод: аномалия, отклонение от нормы.

cards.example: One unusually warm week in January was an anomaly in an otherwise cold winter.

back.en: To state something firmly and confidently.
back.uz: To state something firmly and confidently. Tarjimasi: qat'iy ta'kidlamoq.
back.ru: To state something firmly and confidently. Перевод: утверждать, заявлять.

cards.example: In her speech, the author asserted that every child deserves access to books.

back.en: Logical and consistent; with parts that fit together clearly.
back.uz: Logical and consistent; with parts that fit together clearly. Tarjimasi: izchil, mantiqiy bog'langan.
back.ru: Logical and consistent; with parts that fit together clearly. Перевод: связный, последовательный.

cards.example: After several drafts, the essay finally presented a coherent argument.

back.en: To admit, often reluctantly, that something is true.
back.uz: To admit, often reluctantly, that something is true. Tarjimasi: (istamay) tan olmoq, yon bermoq.
back.ru: To admit, often reluctantly, that something is true. Перевод: (неохотно) признавать, уступать.

cards.example: The critic conceded that the film was beautifully shot, even though he disliked its plot.

back.en: Very different from each other; hard to compare.
back.uz: Very different from each other; hard to compare. Tarjimasi: bir-biridan tubdan farq qiladigan.
back.ru: Very different from each other; hard to compare. Перевод: совершенно разный, несопоставимый.

cards.example: The festival brought together disparate groups, from farmers to software engineers.

back.en: To make something clear by explaining it.
back.uz: To make something clear by explaining it. Tarjimasi: tushuntirib bermoq, oydinlashtirmoq.
back.ru: To make something clear by explaining it. Перевод: разъяснять, проливать свет.

cards.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to elucidate how the heart pumps blood.
